install.title: Install Relio on your Kobo
install.heroTitle: Add books to your Kobo without a cable
install.heroText: From your phone or computer, you can send books to your Kobo, delete the ones you've finished and go back over what you highlighted. It works over your Wi-Fi, with no account.
install.how1: Tap the Relio icon in the Kobo's top bar.
install.how2: Scan the code with your phone.
install.how3: Your library opens in the browser.
install.libraryText: Drag books onto the page, or pick them from your phone. EPUBs are converted to KEPUB as they're sent, so you get the Kobo layout and reading stats.
install.bookText: Open a book to change a highlight's colour, add a note, download the file or delete it from the Kobo.
install.plugText: Connect the e-reader to this computer with a USB cable, then tap Connect on its screen.
install.pickText: Choose the KOBOeReader drive in the window that opens, then accept the change.
install.pickDenied: The browser refused access. Try again and choose the KOBOeReader drive itself.
install.pickNotKobo: “{name}” isn't a Kobo. Choose the KOBOeReader drive itself.
install.installText: Relio copies an update package to the e-reader. It doesn't touch your books or settings.
install.copyFailed: The copy failed: {reason}. Make sure the Kobo is still plugged in, then try again.
install.replacePending: An update is already waiting to be installed on the Kobo. Replace it with Relio?
install.finishText: Eject the Kobo and unplug it. It installs Relio while restarting, which takes about a minute, but only if the battery is at 20% or more. Then turn on Wi-Fi and the Relio icon shows up in the top bar.
install.fallbackTitle: This browser can't write to the Kobo
install.fallbackText: Direct installation works in Chrome or Edge on a computer. Here, download the package and copy it yourself into the Kobo's hidden .kobo folder.
install.q1: Which Kobo models does it work on?
install.a1: I've only tried it on a Kobo Clara Colour with firmware 4.46. Other recent models run the same software, so they should work, but I can't promise it yet. If you try one, let me know on GitHub how it went.
install.a2: No. The e-reader serves the dashboard itself, and your phone or computer connects to it directly over your Wi-Fi. There's no account and no server in between.
install.q3: Does it change my books or settings?
install.a3: Installing adds an icon and a small background program. Your books only change when you ask: when you add one, delete one or edit a highlight.
install.a4: When Wi-Fi is on, the Kobo looks for a new version about once a day. Updates are signed, and the Kobo refuses anything I didn't sign. A new version downloads in the background and a dot appears on the Relio icon. It installs when the Kobo restarts, or right away from the Relio panel. To turn the checks off, create an empty file named no-updates in the .adds/relio folder.
install.q5: How do I turn it off?
install.a5: Create an empty file named disable-plugin in the .adds/relio folder of the e-reader, then restart it. The icon and its panel go away until you delete the file. A proper uninstaller is planned.
install.a6: No. It's an independent open source project, not affiliated with Rakuten Kobo.
install.footerLicense: Relio is open source, under the Apache License 2.0.
